csv_project_name: AE for CRISI Redesign Alabama Project
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Birmingham s (the City) Department of Transportation welcomes qualified firms and partners to work with us on projects that shape and support our community. The City is pleased to announce the upcoming release of a Request for Qualifications (RFQ) seeking qualified professional firms to provide Engineering, NEPA, and Project Management Services as part of the of the FRA CRISI Grant funded R.E.D.E.S.I.G.N Alabama Project. The scope of work in this RFQ includes project management, development preliminary engineering of civil, structural, and railroad work, development and management of NEPA documentation and other environmental work, project coordination with Norfolk Southern and the City of Trussville (AL), manage right of way appraisals and research, and develop the Final Performance Report.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Inspection Services, Site Evaluation/Selection, Sanitation Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics
